en: Moving to Europe with a business? Here's the route.
In Slovakia, two ways in: sole trader, or company executive.
Step one. A business plan, on the ministry's template.
Step two. Funds on a business account.
Step three. The first application goes through an embassy.
Decision in up to ninety days. Valid up to three years.
To renew, the business has to show its taxes.
DocRoute has this route step by step, plus Czechia and Austria. Link in channel.
